items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1976-02-19
items.q: the Roosevelt administration, at that time, through its brain trust with Raymond Moley and Rexford Guy Tugwell, came up with this crackpot program

ctx.x: But you remember this from an early age?

Well, I remember it for quite a while. It didn't start until 1946. Oh, I see. But I had an interest in it because of my own early career, which had to do with the fact that I had the highest IQ score in the nation on the original college... When they first instituted the college IQ testing for a freshman the first year, I had the highest IQ in the nation. And the Roosevelt administration, at that time, through its brain trust with Raymond Moley and Rexford Guy Tugwell, came up with this crackpot program of…
Mm-hmm. That's how you met Rivera.
